name: TrAC Kigali Data Centre (TransAfrica Communications)
notes: Operator site markets cloud and 'tier 3 data centre hosting'; aggregator places facility at Telecom House, 8 KG 7 Ave, Kacyiru, Gasabo, Kigali; PeeringDB org 29956 (Kigali, Gasabo). A for marketed service claim (trac.africa), C for physical facility details - no verified rack count/MW/Uptime certification. Per RW methodology record per-operator (Telecom House hosts TrAC, RINEX, NCSA separately). 'Tier 3' is marketing language, not verified Uptime certification.

name: PAIX Kigali (Kigali Innovation City)
notes: PAIX official location page (paix.io/en/locations/kigali) now lists a Kigali data centre within Kigali Innovation City (~10 km/20 min from Kigali International Airport); aggregators list 3 MW carrier-neutral facility; PeeringDB fac 15731 exists. Official page existence is A for marketing, but no construction/go-live/commissioning evidence verified - keep announced/unknown until PAIX/RDB/RURA or press confirms build/operational status. 3 MW from aggregator listing per methodology.

name: Africa Data Centres (ADC) Kigali
notes: ADC announced Nov 2022 a 2 MW purpose-built data centre in Kigali with ground break Q1 2023; DCD 2026-06 (Otech article) states project status unclear. No operator facility page or construction evidence found - keep announced/unknown per methodology; 2 MW from the 2022 announcement.

name: Otech (Omantel) x Broadband Systems Corporation data centre (Rwanda)
notes: DCD (2026-06-03): Otech (ex-Oman Data Park, Omantel technology arm launched Feb 2026) and Kigali ISP BSC signed MoU to co-invest in an AI-ready Tier III-standards data centre in Rwanda; location undisclosed. B for verified MoU, U for site/construction - keep announced/mou status until tender/construction/inauguration evidence per methodology.

name: AOS Ltd colocation (Kigali Business Centre)
notes: Local IT-service provider colocation listed at Kigali Business Centre, KN 5 Rd (not carrier-neutral; listing last updated 2023-06); DCD 2026 names AOS among three existing Kigali operators. C-grade lead - current operations unverified.

name: RINEX (Rwanda Internet Exchange), Telecom House
notes: Operating IXP at Telecom House, KG 7, Kacyiru, Gasabo (AS329521), set up by RURA 2009, ~15 members late 2025. Interconnection infrastructure, NOT datacenter capacity - recorded per methodology as ixp facility at the Kigali interconnection anchor.

name: MTN Centre Kigali core facility
notes: MTN Centre Kigali facility on PeeringDB (fac 11839); MTN Rwanda launched 5G June 2025 (Kigali + Kamonyi sites per IGIHE). Telco core/network facility lead - count as datacenter only with hosting/cloud evidence; PeeringDB entry is interconnection metadata (B/C) per methodology.

name: Raxio RW1 Kigali (lead)
notes: Aggregator-only listing 'Raxio RW1 - Rwanda's first carrier-neutral Tier III-designed data centre' (Gasabo, Kigali); Raxio official data-centres page does NOT list Rwanda (only Angola, Cote d'Ivoire, DRC, Ethiopia, Mozambique, Tanzania, Uganda). Unverified lead - keep U until Raxio/RURA/primary press confirms per methodology.

name: Paratus Rwanda data centre (lead)
notes: Aggregator listing 'Paratus Rwanda Data Centre Kigali'; Paratus official 2026 Goma-Mombasa fibre route announcement runs via Kigali with Paratus Rwanda licensed, but official data-centre menu lists Angola/Namibia/Zambia, not Rwanda. Connectivity/PoP lead, not confirmed DC - U per methodology.

name: Rwanda Space Agency teleport / ground station (Mwulire, Rwamagana)
developer: Rwanda Space Agency (RSA) with ATLAS Space Operations
notes: RSA teleport at Mwulire, Rwamagana District (Eastern Province): ATLAS Space Operations activated 9.3m ground-station antenna July 2025 supporting COSMIC-2 weather data; teleport earned World Teleport Association (WTA) Tier 3 certification June 2026 - first fully certified teleport in sub-Saharan Africa. Edge/telecom ground-station facility, not commercial datacenter - recorded as edge_ground_station per methodology.

name: Northern Province
notes: no_projects: No datacenter activity in Northern Province (Musanze, Gicumbi, Rulindo) found; university labs/tourism-tech/backbone PoPs only. Negative commercial expectation confirmed per methodology.

name: Western Province
notes: no_projects: No datacenter activity in Western Province (Rubavu, Rusizi, Karongi, Nyamasheke) found; DRC-border fibre and Lake Kivu methane power are energy/connectivity context only. Negative commercial expectation confirmed per methodology.

name: Southern Province
notes: no_projects: No datacenter activity in Southern Province found; Huye (University of Rwanda) computing rooms and Kamonyi MTN 5G network sites (IGIHE) are not datacenters per methodology (university computing and telco edge excluded). Negative commercial expectation confirmed.
